localmaxxing.notes: Constrained simple-site quality benchmark, not unconstrained website generation. MiniMax M2.7 AutoRound INT4 on 4x Arc Pro B70, TP4, forced XPU graph with no-op XPU comm capture, scaffolded assistant prefill, tight structured HTML suffix, prefix caching. One validated warmup excluded from measured service throughput. Rerun result: 30/30 accepted, 0 rejects, 100% first-pass, 94.46 effective measured output tok/s; companion run: 94.53 tok/s. Approx prompt/input throughput derived from vLLM progress and prompt length; strict harness validated complete HTML/body, exact list items, required copy, no control chars, no malformed angle markup.
